verdict.rationale: CompatTelRunner.exe is a signed Microsoft Compatibility Telemetry binary running as SYSTEM under a standard svchost parent, executing its normal UpdateSoftwareInventoryW task. The accompanying Sysmon EventID 9 raw-access events from the System process across HarddiskVolume1-3 are consistent with routine Windows system/indexing activity and show no sign of credential dumping or tampering.
